title: Two Wheels of Suches

services.name: Cabins
services.desc: There are 8 cabins. Each cabin has two twin beds, electricity, heater, and ceiling fan; linens/towels are included. Cabins are located just a short walk to the bathhouse and lodge. No smoking is allowed in cabins. 2-Night Minimum on weekends is strictly enforced. When booking please ensure you have selected two nights. NOTE: Plus Tax on all 7% GA State sales tax and 5% Union County lodging tax (12% Total). Please review our cancellation policy when making a reservation. Two Wheels of Suches Motorcycle Campground, Restaurant and Lodge offers riders, traveling in the North Georgia Mountains, a place to stop and grab a bite, camp, stay in the lodge or cabins, meet up with old friends
